name: master-agent
description: NOC investigation router — discovers specialist Agent Cards, routes by alertname/keywords/LLM, and orchestrates A2A tasks to prometheus, rds, kubernetes, and freshservice agents.

skills.name: Investigate Alert
skills.description: Route NOC alert context to the correct specialist agent and return investigation results
examples: Investigate CrashLoopBackOff for pod payments-7d4b8c-x2k9f in namespace production
What is the replica count of this deployment?
Get logs for the crashing pod

skills.name: Kubernetes Routing
skills.description: Route Kube* and pod crash alerts to kubernetes-agent

skills.name: Prometheus Routing
skills.description: Route metric and latency alerts to prometheus-agent
examples: P99 latency spike on checkout service

skills.name: Freshservice / Incident Routing
skills.description: Route MIM, incident, ticket, and Freshstatus questions to freshservice-agent
examples: What is the status of MI-4301250?
Give me a briefing on recent Freshdesk outages
How many MIM incidents in April?
